def parse_frontmatter(raw):
    metadata={}
    content=raw
    if raw.startswith("---\n") or raw.startswith("---\r\n"):
        lines=raw.splitlines()
        if lines and lines[0].strip()=="---":
            end_idx=-1
            for idx in range(1,len(lines)):
                if lines[idx].strip()=="---":
                    end_idx=idx
                    break
            if end_idx!=-1:
                fm_lines=lines[1:end_idx]
                for line in fm_lines:
                    line=line.strip()
                    if not line or line.startswith("#"):
                        continue
                    if ":" not in line:
                        continue
                    key,val=line.split(":",1)
                    key=key.strip()
                    val=val.strip()
                    if val.startswith("[") and val.endswith("]"):
                        inner=val[1:-1].strip()
                        if not inner:
                            arr=[]
                        else:
                            parts=[p.strip() for p in inner.split(",")]
                            arr=[]
                            for p in parts:
                                p=p.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
                                if p:
                                    arr.append(p)
                            val=arr
                    elif (val.startswith('"') and val.endswith('"')) or (val.startswith("'") and val.endswith("'")):
                        val=val[1:-1]
                    metadata[key]=val
                content="\n".join(lines[end_idx+1:])
                if content.startswith("\n"):
                    content=content[1:]
    return metadata, content

def extract_title(metadata, content_without_fm, raw):
    if "title" in metadata and isinstance(metadata["title"], str) and metadata["title"].strip():
        return metadata["title"].strip()
    for line in content_without_fm.splitlines():
        m=re.match(r'^\s*#\s+(.*)', line)
        if m:
            t=m.group(1).strip()
            t=re.sub(r'\s+#+\s*$','',t)
            return t
    return ""

def extract_tags(metadata, body, config):
    tags=[]
    if "tags" in metadata:
        val=metadata["tags"]
        if isinstance(val, list):
            tags.extend(val)
        elif isinstance(val, str):
            if "," in val:
                tags.extend([p.strip() for p in val.split(",") if p.strip()])
            else:
                tags.extend([p.strip() for p in val.split() if p.strip()])
    hashtags_enabled=config.get("format",{}).get("markdown",{}).get("hashtags", True)
    if hashtags_enabled:
        pattern=r'(?:^|[\s])#([A-Za-z0-9_\-]+)'
        for m in re.finditer(pattern, body):
            tag=m.group(1)
            if tag:
                tags.append(tag)
        colon_enabled=config.get("format",{}).get("markdown",{}).get("colon-tags", False)
        if colon_enabled:
            for m in re.finditer(r':([A-Za-z0-9_\-:]+):', body):
                tags.append(m.group(1))
    seen=set()
    uniq=[]
    for t in tags:
        if t not in seen:
            seen.add(t)
            uniq.append(t)
    return uniq

def parse_links_and_snippets(raw, paras):
    links=[]
    for para in paras:
        if not para.strip():
            continue
        snippet=para.strip()
        # wiki
        for m in re.finditer(r'\[\[([^\]]+)\]\]', para):
            inner=m.group(1)
            href=inner
            title=inner
            if "|" in inner:
                href, title = inner.split("|",1)
                href=href.strip()
                title=title.strip()
            else:
                href=href.strip()
            # remove anchor?
            href=href.split("#")[0].strip()
            try:
                start=raw.index(snippet)
            except:
                start=raw.find(para)
                if start==-1:
                    start=0
            end=start+len(snippet)
            links.append({"href": href, "title": title, "snippet": snippet, "snippet_start": start, "snippet_end": end, "type": "wiki-link", "external": 0})
        # markdown
        for m in re.finditer(r'\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\)', para):
            text=m.group(1)
            href=m.group(2).strip()
            title=text if text else href
            external=1 if href.startswith("http://") or href.startswith("https://") or href.startswith("mailto:") else 0
            try:
                start=raw.index(snippet)
            except:
                start=raw.find(para)
                if start==-1:
                    start=0
            end=start+len(snippet)
            links.append({"href": href, "title": title, "snippet": snippet, "snippet_start": start, "snippet_end": end, "type": "markdown", "external": external})
    return links

def parse_note_file(notebook_dir, rel_path, config):
    abs_path=os.path.join(notebook_dir, rel_path)
    raw=open(abs_path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore").read()
    checksum=hashlib.sha256(raw.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    metadata, content_without_fm = parse_frontmatter(raw)
    title=extract_title(metadata, content_without_fm, raw)
    body_content=content_without_fm
    lines=body_content.splitlines()
    idx=0
    while idx < len(lines) and lines[idx].strip()=="":
        idx+=1
    if idx < len(lines) and re.match(r'^\s*#\s+', lines[idx]):
        idx+=1
        while idx < len(lines) and lines[idx].strip()=="":
            idx+=1
    body="\n".join(lines[idx:]).strip()
    if body:
        paras=[p.strip() for p in re.split(r'\n\s*\n', body) if p.strip()!='']
        lead=paras[0] if paras else ""
    else:
        paras=[]
        lead=""
    text_for_hashtags=body
    tags=extract_tags(metadata, text_for_hashtags, config)
    word_count=len(raw.split())
    links=parse_links_and_snippets(raw, paras)
    snippets=[lead] if lead else []
    filename=os.path.basename(rel_path)
    filenameStem=os.path.splitext(filename)[0]
    return {"path":rel_path,"sortable_path":rel_path,"filename":filename,"filenameStem":filenameStem,"title":title,"lead":lead,"body":body,"raw_content":raw,"word_count":word_count,"checksum":checksum,"metadata":metadata,"tags":tags,"links":links,"snippets":snippets,"paras":paras}

def index_notebook(notebook_dir, verbose=False, quiet=False, force=False):
    config=load_config(notebook_dir)
    exclude_patterns=config.get("note",{}).get("exclude",[])
    if exclude_patterns is None:
        exclude_patterns=[]
    extension=config.get("note",{}).get("extension","md")
    db_path=os.path.join(notebook_dir, ".zk", "notebook.db")
    conn=sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    cur=conn.cursor()
    all_notes=[]
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(notebook_dir):
        if ".zk" in dirs:
            dirs.remove(".zk")
        rel_root=os.path.relpath(root, notebook_dir)
        if rel_root==".":
            rel_root=""
        for fname in files:
            if not fname.endswith("."+extension):
                continue
            rel_path=os.path.join(rel_root, fname) if rel_root else fname
            rel_path=rel_path.replace(os.sep, "/")
            excluded=False
            for pat in exclude_patterns:
                if fnmatch.fnmatch(rel_path, pat) or fnmatch.fnmatch(fname, pat):
                    excluded=True
                    break
            if excluded:
                continue
            all_notes.append(rel_path)
    cur.execute("SELECT id, path, checksum, created, modified FROM notes")
    existing={row[1]: (row[0], row[2], row[3], row[4]) for row in cur.fetchall()}
    added=0
    modified_cnt=0
    removed=0
    seen=set()
    # detailed per file status for verbose
    status_lines=[]
    for rel_path in sorted(all_notes):
        seen.add(rel_path)
        abs_path=os.path.join(notebook_dir, rel_path)
        parsed=parse_note_file(notebook_dir, rel_path, config)
        checksum=parsed["checksum"]
        if rel_path in existing:
            nid, old_checksum, old_created, old_modified = existing[rel_path]
            if not force and checksum==old_checksum:
                status_lines.append(("- unchanged", rel_path))
                continue
            else:
                # modified
                stat=os.stat(abs_path)
                try:
                    ns=stat.st_mtime_ns
                    sec=ns//1_000_000_000
                    nsec=ns%1_000_000_000
                    dt=datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(sec, tz=timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=nsec//1000)
                    db_modified=f"{dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}.{nsec:09d}+00:00"
                except:
                    dt=datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(os.path.getmtime(abs_path), tz=timezone.utc)
                    db_modified=dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f+00:00")
                cur.execute("UPDATE notes SET title=?, lead=?, body=?, raw_content=?, word_count=?, checksum=?, modified=?, metadata=?, filename=?, sortable_path=? WHERE id=?",
                            (parsed["title"], parsed["lead"], parsed["body"], parsed["raw_content"], parsed["word_count"], checksum, db_modified, json.dumps(parsed["metadata"]), parsed["filename"], parsed["sortable_path"], nid))

def render_template(template_str, context):
    def slugify(text):
        text=text.lower()
        text=re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+','-',text)
        text=text.strip("-")
        return text
    def format_date(val, fmt=None):
        if isinstance(val, str) and val=="now":
            dt=context.get("_now", datetime.datetime.now(timezone.utc))
        elif isinstance(val, datetime.datetime):
            dt=val
        else:
            try:
                dt=datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(str(val).replace("Z","+00:00"))
            except:
                dt=context.get("_now", datetime.datetime.now(timezone.utc))
        if fmt is None:
            return dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
        try:
            return dt.strftime(fmt)
        except:
            return dt.isoformat()
    pattern=re.compile(r'{{\s*(.*?)\s*}}')
    def repl(m):
        expr=m.group(1).strip()
        if expr.startswith("slug "):
            arg=expr[5:].strip()
            val=context.get(arg,"")
            return slugify(str(val))
        elif expr.startswith("format-date"):
            inner=expr[len("format-date"):].strip()
            parts=re.findall(r'"([^"]*)"|\'([^\']*)\'|(\S+)', inner)
            tokens=[]
            for a,b,c in parts:
                if a:
                    tokens.append(a)
                elif b:
                    tokens.append(b)
                elif c:
                    tokens.append(c)
            if not tokens:
                return ""
            val_token=tokens[0]
            if val_token=="now":
                val="now"
            else:
                val=context.get(val_token, val_token)
            fmt=tokens[1] if len(tokens)>1 else None
            return format_date(val, fmt)
        elif expr.startswith("json "):
            return json.dumps(context)
        elif "." in expr:
            parts=expr.split(".",1)
            base, rest=parts[0], parts[1]
            if base=="extra":
                return str(context.get("extra",{}).get(rest,""))
            elif base=="metadata":
                return str(context.get("metadata",{}).get(rest,""))
            else:
                return ""
        else:
            if expr=="title-or-path":
                return context.get("title") or context.get("path") or ""
            if expr=="filename-stem":
                return context.get("filenameStem","")
            if expr=="now":
                return datetime.datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f +0000 UTC")
            return str(context.get(expr,""))
    return pattern.sub(repl, template_str)

    if os.path.isabs(template_path) or template_path.startswith("~/"):

def parse_date_str(s):
    # Try to parse many formats: ISO, YYYY-MM-DD, relative like "today", "yesterday", "last week", "last two weeks", "2 weeks ago" ?
    s=s.strip()
    now=datetime.datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    low=s.lower()
    if low in ("today","now"):
        return now
    if low=="yesterday":
        return now - datetime.timedelta(days=1)
    if low=="tomorrow":
        return now + datetime.timedelta(days=1)
    # last X weeks
    m=re.match(r'last\s+(\d+)?\s*weeks?', low)
    if m:
        num=m.group(1)
        n=int(num) if num else 1
        return now - datetime.timedelta(weeks=n)
    m=re.match(r'last\s+two\s+weeks', low)
    if m:
        return now - datetime.timedelta(weeks=2)
    if low=="last week":
        return now - datetime.timedelta(weeks=1)
    if low=="last month":
        return now - datetime.timedelta(days=30)
    if low=="last year":
        return now - datetime.timedelta(days=365)
    # generic: try dateutil via fromisoformat and strptime
    # Try ISO with T
    try:
        # handle like 2026-09-06T14:07:32.529984522Z -> need to truncate nanoseconds to microseconds
        # Replace Z with +00:00 and truncate to 6 digits after dot
        t=s
        if t.endswith("Z"):
            t=t[:-1]+"+00:00"
        # truncate nanoseconds to microseconds (6 digits)
        m2=re.match(r'(.+\.\d{6})\d*(.*)', t)
        if m2:
            t=m2.group(1)+m2.group(2)
        dt=datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(t)
        if dt.tzinfo is None:
            dt=dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        return dt
    except:
        pass
    for fmt in ("%Y-%m-%d", "%Y/%m/%d", "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S", "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", "%d/%m/%Y", "%m/%d/%Y"):
        try:
            dt=datetime.datetime.strptime(s, fmt)
            dt=dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
            return dt
        except:
            continue
    # fallback: try parse as YYYY-MM-DD without time
    try:
        dt=datetime.datetime.strptime(s[:10], "%Y-%m-%d")
        dt=dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        return dt
    except:
        pass
    # default return now
    return now
